headline: PERRON GOES TO FEASIBILITY: 774K OZ AT 12.1 g/t — AMEX GOLD MINING BORN AS PRODUCTION ERA OPENS (TSXV:AMX)
snippet: Amex Exploration Inc. (TSXV:AMX) became Amex Gold Mining Inc. effective July 3, 2026, signaling the company's transition from exploration to production following a positive Phase 1 Feasibility Study for the Perron Gold Project in Quebec: proven and probable mineable reserve of 1,989 kt at 12.1 g/t for 774,000 ounces of gold, initial capital of CAD$193.9 million, and a two-year pre-production period followed by five years of commercial toll-milling operations. Amex also received key bulk sampling permits for Perron, advancing what is now among the highest-grade feasibility-stage gold deposits in Canada.

headline: 738 METRES OF PORPHYRY CONFIRMED AT TOLITA — GOLD HART COPPER LOGS COMPANY'S LONGEST INTERCEPT EVER IN CHILE'S VICUÑA DISTRICT (TSXV:HART)
snippet: Gold Hart Copper Corp. (TSXV:HART) announced July 2 that spring 2026 drill hole DDHTOL01 — drilled to 1,053 metres total depth using a more powerful rig — intersected approximately 738 metres of continuous gold-copper-molybdenum-silver porphyry mineralisation at the Tolita target in Chile's Vicuña District, the company's longest single intercept on record; assay grades are pending. Tolita sits in the world-class Vicuña porphyry belt that hosts Los Helados (NuevaUnión/Teck/Newmont), Filo del Sol (Filo Corp.), and Josemaria (Josemaria Resources), and this interval confirms the large-scale footprint of the Tolita system ahead of assays.

headline: GOLDGROUP VOTE PASSES — GRC-GOLDGROUP THREE-MINE MEXICAN COMBINATION CONFIRMED, CLOSING ~JULY 17
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Goldgroup Mining Inc. (TSXV:GGA)
snippet: Goldgroup Mining Inc. (TSXV:GGA) confirmed July 3 that all resolutions at its July 2 Annual General and Special Meeting were approved, including the arrangement with Gold Resource Corporation (NYSE:GORO) combining GRC's Don David Gold Mine in Oaxaca with Goldgroup's San Francisco and Cerro Prieto mines in Sonora, Mexico — with 280 million-plus shares voted (92.88% of outstanding). Under the all-scrip deal, GRC shareholders receive 1.4476 Goldgroup shares per share and will own approximately 40% of the combined company; closing is targeted on or about July 17, 2026, subject to customary conditions.

headline: SILVER ABOVE $60 FOR FIRST TIME IN THREE WEEKS — RATE-HIKE BETS COLLAPSE AS METALS SNAP THREE-MONTH LOSING STREAK
snippet: Silver (XAG/USD) climbed above $60.00 per ounce during the July 2 session — the first close above that level in three weeks — as Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh's comments on easing inflation expectations triggered a repricing of September rate-hike probability below 50%, dragging down real Treasury yields and sparking a wave of short-covering across the precious metals complex. Silver's recovery from the $55–57 range to above $60 within 72 hours represents the sharpest bounce since February's selloff, with analysts identifying $65 as the next meaningful resistance level required to confirm a sustained recovery rather than a short-covering snapback.

headline: IMWELO EPCM SIGNED — LAKE VICTORIA GOLD APPOINTS TANZANIAN-LED CONTRACTOR AT FULLY PERMITTED EAST AFRICA GOLD PROJECT (TSXV:LVG)
snippet: Lake Victoria Gold Corp. (TSXV:LVG) announced July 2 that its Tanzanian subsidiary Tembo Gold (T) Limited has formalized the appointment of City Engineering Company Ltd. (CECL) as primary EPCM contractor — with Sutton Consulting International as international technical partner — for the fully permitted Imwelo Gold Project in Tanzania, following Mining Commission approval on June 29 under Tanzania's Mining Local Content Regulations 2018. The appointment moves Imwelo into final engineering, procurement planning, and construction preparation, with CECL serving as local engineering authority and commercial lead and Sutton providing specialist African mine-development expertise.

headline: 1,156 g/t AgEq OVER 6.28m AT SILVER HILL — METALSOURCE STEP-OUT EXTENDS ULTRA HIGH-GRADE POLYMETALLIC CORRIDOR (CSE:MSM)
source_name: Investing News Network / Metalsource Mining Inc. (CSE:MSM)
snippet: Metalsource Mining Inc. (CSE:MSM) reported June 30 that hole SH26-19 returned 6.28 metres grading 1,156 g/t silver equivalent — including 3.6 metres at 1,789 g/t AgEq — extending the emerging high-grade polymetallic corridor approximately 33 metres down-plunge at the Silver Hill project in British Columbia, with consistent silver, gold, lead, and zinc mineralisation confirmed in zones of massive sphalerite. With world-class silver grades demonstrated across multiple systematic step-out holes, Silver Hill is developing the geological signature of a high-grade underground silver-polymetallic mine, with every result improving management's understanding of system continuity and orientation.

headline: MINING AMERICAS STEPS UP TO THE BIG BOARD — NEVADA/MEXICO GOLD PRODUCER JOINS TSX FROM TSXV (TSX:MAI)
snippet: Mining Americas Inc. (TSX:MAI) — formerly Minera Alamos Inc. — began trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange at market open on July 3, 2026, graduating voluntarily from the TSX Venture Exchange where its shares were delisted at the July 2 close; no changes to share capital, CUSIP, or ISIN were required. The company is a growing North American gold production and development company with operating mines in Nevada and Mexico and development assets in Arizona, joining the senior exchange alongside larger mid-tier producers as it scales its production profile.

headline: LABRADOR GOLD STAKES WHITE GOLD DISTRICT — PACIFIC RIDGE OPTION CLOSED, SOIL SAMPLING UNDERWAY AT MARIPOSA AND EUREKA DOME (TSXV:LAB)
snippet: Labrador Gold Corp. (TSXV:LAB) announced July 2 that it closed the first tranche of its option agreement with Pacific Ridge Exploration — paying CA$100,000 cash and issuing 800,000 shares — and that field programs are underway at the Mariposa and Eureka Dome projects in Yukon's White Gold District, with 1,966 soil samples collected to date at Mariposa. Mineralisation age at Mariposa (~155 Ma) is consistent with the Golden Saddle deposit at neighbouring White Gold Corp., a key geological correlative; six significant gold occurrences have been delineated across the tenure including the most advanced Skookum Main and Skookum West prospects.

headline: NORSEMONT DRILLS 9 HOLES IN 5 ZONES AT CHOQUELIMPIE — MULTI-STYLE AU-AG BRECCIA SYSTEM OUTLINED IN CHILE HIGH ANDES (CSE:NOM)
snippet: Norsemont Mining Inc. (CSE:NOM) provided a July 2 update on drilling at its Choquelimpie gold-silver project in Chile's Tarapacá Region, confirming nine drill holes totalling 2,187 metres completed year-to-date across five key zones — Choque, Suri, Vizcacha, Hundimiento, and Española — with two additional holes underway offsetting known mineralisation extensions. Early drilling has confirmed multiple gold-bearing structural styles including hydrothermal breccias, porphyry-related quartz-magnetite veinlets, and quartz-mica-sulfide alteration zones; metallurgical and 3D geological studies planned for later 2026 will refine precious and base metal relationships ahead of a resource growth campaign.

headline: GOLDSEEK WEEKLY #72: GOLD, SILVER AND MINERS AWAIT THE CATALYST — WHAT BREAKS THE H2 CONSOLIDATION
snippet: GoldSeek's weekly Issue #72 roundup frames the pre-holiday metals setup as a market that was awaiting a decisive catalyst to break three months of consolidation — a catalyst that arrived on schedule with Thursday's June NFP printing 57,000 versus the 110,000 consensus, triggering GDX's best single session since February and silver's first close above $60 in three weeks. The column covers analyst debate on whether the payrolls-driven reversal has staying power heading into the seasonally stronger Q3–Q4 window, or whether thin July 4 holiday liquidity amplified a short-covering move that may retrace once normal trading resumes.

headline: DISCOVERY SILVER BECOMES DISCOVERY MINING — CORDERO SILVER GIANT MEETS PORCUPINE GOLD AND KIDD COPPER; NEW NAME SIGNALS DIVERSIFIED AMBITION (TSX:DSV)
snippet: Discovery Silver Corp. (TSX:DSV) began trading as Discovery Mining Ltd. at market open July 3 after TSX approval of its name change, reflecting the company's evolution from a single-asset silver developer into a multi-commodity miner — it holds 100% of the Cordero project in Chihuahua (one of the world's largest undeveloped silver deposits at ~1.5 billion oz AgEq) alongside the Porcupine gold complex in Timmins, Ontario (acquired April 2025) and the Kidd Operations acquired from Glencore in June 2026 (adding copper, zinc, and silver production). The rebrand signals management's ambition to operate as a diversified intermediate producer rather than a pure silver development company.
